messages:
Maria: quick q — we're getting a lot of client requests with mixed embedding dims (512 / 768 / 1024). Right now they mostly hit a 413 or a terse 'dim mismatch'. Can we agree on a server-side contract?
Aj: don't silently mutate client tensors. :thumbsup: we should offer opt-in transformations and clear headers so SDKs can declare intent.
Sam: runtime note: padding to larger dims is expensive; trimming is lossy. We can either: reject (current), auto-pad (costly), downsample (lossy), or route to a compatible model variant. Need to weigh cost vs UX.
Lina: from product: most users just want an actionable error and a one-click fix from the Console. Suggestion: Console shows exact client_dims + suggested fixes + estimated cost delta.
Chris: telemetry proposal: emit embed.dim_mismatch event with fields: client_dims, model_dims, decision, cost_estimate_usd, tenant_id. We also need histograms: embed.latency_by_dim and embed.unit_cost_by_dim.
Tal: quota semantics question: if we route a 512->1024 request (via padding or variant), does the tenant pay for 1024 units? I think yes, but we must show that clearly in the Console and billing.
Hannah: UX idea: show inline 'Fix in SDK' snippet + toggle to enable server-side transforms per-tenant. Default: OFF. Console banner could say "Enable server transforms for this tenant (safe, may increase cost)".
Aj: SDK header sketch — clients opt in by sending Accept-Embed-Transform header. Example: 
```
Accept-Embed-Transform: pad=up|downsample|split    # pad=up -> pad to next supported dim
X-Embed-Dims: 768                              # client-reported dim
```
Sam: implementable path for runtime: if header present and pad=up, route to next larger dim model or pad on-device in GPU runtime. We should gate behind a feature flag + trace tag.
Maria: good. Need exact header names and default behaviors so SDKs and docs can ship. I'll draft product copy.
Chris: also add a boolean telemetry flag 'transform_applied' and include transformation_type. We want to be able to slice cost/regressions by tenant and transform type.
Tal: rollout plan: opt-in per-tenant for 5% initially. Monitor error rate, latency p95, and cost delta. If cost delta > X% or error rate increases, auto-disable.
Hannah: Console mock: show suggested fix + estimated USD delta and a CTA 'Enable pad for this tenant'. Also a small toggle 'Apply to new requests only' vs 'Rewrite historical requests' (likely only new).
Aj: SDK change: when tenant toggles "server transforms", SDK should add the header for future requests. We'll deprecate silent client-side auto-pad once this ships.
Sam: I'll add runtime PR with feature flag. Need tests for latency regression with padded tensors and for trace propagation.
Maria: owners: Aj -> SDK header + docs; Sam -> runtime router + feature flag; Chris -> telemetry schema + dashboards; Tal -> rollout/runbook; Lina/Hannah -> Console copy + mock. I'll coordinate deps.
deploy_bot: canary deploy queued (canary window 2h)
Chris: I'll add dashboard panels: cost-by-decision, errors-by-decision, latency-p95-by-dim. Also add alert if unit_cost_by_dim delta > 20% over baseline.
Tal: add quota rule: when transform applied, map to the transformed route's quota bucket. Doc that in console.
Maria: thanks all — if you post PR links here I can tag infra/security for review. :heart:
Aj: will post SDK PR this afternoon.
Sam: runtime PR by tomorrow AM, will include the X-Trace tag and telemetry hooks.
Maria: perfect. We'll demo in eng-platform sync next week.
summary: Discussion about handling clients sending varying embedding dims: opt-in server transforms, headers, telemetry and Console UX/rollout plan
